fusions.name: Anvil Drop
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 18 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pile Driver
fusions.desc: Drives jaws into the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss or elite enemy's maximum health.

fusions.name: Plate Flat
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Peen Reflex
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you deal 30% more damage for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
